name: Lotte Energy Materials Corporation
summary: Lotte Energy Materials Corporation produces and sells elecfoils in Korea and internationally. Its elecfoils are used as core material for electronic products. The company offers I2B that creates the anode current collector in rechargeable lithium battery; and IHT, special elecfoil for flexible printed circuit board and flexible copper clad laminate; and IUT, an ultrathin elecfoil developed suitable for microcircuits, high density, high integration, and high layering of PCBs.
